cutoff_window.policy: Only public sources with a visible publication or update timestamp within the preceding seven days qualify.

qualifying_updates.affected_boundary: Model-download URL trust boundary; crafted URLs can cause requests to internal network destinations.
qualifying_updates.summary: Medium-severity SSRF disclosure for Multi Model Server 1.1.11 and earlier; no exploitation claim was reported.
qualifying_updates.upstream_routing: Keep locally: security-specific SSRF boundary; route only broad product catalog facts to ai-wiki.

qualifying_updates.affected_boundary: Post-transform component authorization on direct FastMCP calls.
qualifying_updates.summary: Medium-severity authorization bypass disclosure; patched in FastMCP 3.4.10 and 4.1.2. No exploitation claim was reported.

qualifying_updates.affected_boundary: Unauthenticated MLflow GenAI scorer endpoint outbound request boundary.
qualifying_updates.summary: Medium-severity SSRF disclosure affecting scorer invocation, registration, and GenAI evaluation paths before 3.17.0; no exploitation claim was reported.

qualifying_updates.affected_boundary: M2M OAuth issuer binding and client-secret destination trust.
qualifying_updates.summary: Medium-severity issuer-binding failure could redirect an M2M client secret to an attacker-advertised authorization server; patched in 4.1.2. No exploitation claim was reported.
qualifying_updates.upstream_routing: Keep locally: identity and access control failure.

qualifying_updates.affected_boundary: Persisted namespace tenant isolation in Postgres and SQLite stores.
qualifying_updates.summary: Medium-severity namespace-label collision disclosure across persisted stores; patched versions are 3.1.3 (Postgres) and 3.1.2 (SQLite). No exploitation claim was reported.
qualifying_updates.upstream_routing: Keep locally: tenant-isolation security boundary; route broad LangGraph facts upstream.
